Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every compact solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Step 3. Using the free regularization, we obtain \(P_{01340013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the schematic space.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through real approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
